components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action within a local decision area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: #fff; font: 550 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out, color .16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); border-color: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-hover) 82%, #000); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact outlined action for ordinary operational controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: 550 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out, color .16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--panel-2); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--panel-3); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A visibly destructive action kept separate from ordinary editing.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 55%, var(--line)); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--bad); font: 550 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease-out, border-color .16s ease-out, color .16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 9%, transparent); border-color: var(--bad); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 15%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A recessed operational field with explicit labeling and strong focus feedback.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-camera-name">Camera name</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-camera-name" value="Gate Utama" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 5px; color: var(--muted); font: 500 12px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--field); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .16s ease-out, box-shadow .16s ease-out; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--line-2)); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A compact persistent-rail destination with an accent active marker.
components.html: Monitoring
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; font: 500 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .16s ease-out, color .16s ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"]::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -12px; top: 9px; bottom: 9px; width: 1px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] svg { color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item:active { background: var(--panel-3); }

components.name: Allowed Status Chip
components.description: A point-of-work state label for running or allowed permission state.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 999px; font: 500 11px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-chip-allowed { color: var(--ok); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 45%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 8%, transparent); } .ds-status-chip-allowed:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 68%, var(--line)); } .ds-status-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: A flat, border-defined container for dense operational content.

components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .16s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--line-2); } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; padding: 15px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-card-head h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-card-head p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; } .ds-card-state { color: var(--ok); font-size: 11px; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; color: var(--muted); }

narrative.overview:
The Kiki Control Room is a factual continuation of the established Kiki desktop monitoring world: black and deep navy surfaces, cool one-pixel boundaries, compact outlined controls, and tightly ordered operational information. It should feel like a working console whose visual hierarchy serves scanning, intervention, and verification—not a generic SaaS administration template.

This is a local-only RBAC prototype. Its interface must make simulated state, pending decisions, and permission boundaries legible at the point of work while preserving the density of camera monitoring, reports, settings, logs, and diagnostics. Blue is restrained to navigation, focus, and primary actions; green, amber, and red communicate operational meaning without turning the screen decorative.

The system is desktop-first by contract. Below the desktop gate, the shell and dashboard do not render; a plain explanatory notice replaces them. Inside the gate, hierarchy comes from tonal layering, precise borders, disciplined spacing, and semantic state—not oversized display type, decorative gradients, or ornamental effects.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, ordered operational information with persistent navigation.
Black/navy tonal layers separated by cool one-pixel borders.
Restrained blue action and focus language with semantic green, amber, and red states.
Compact 8–10px corner language, outlined icons, and local permission context.
Explicit prototype boundaries and desktop-only behavior.

rules.name: The One Blue Action Rule
rules.body: Use Control Blue for the clearest next action or selected state; do not flood dense screens with competing blue fills.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Green means operational or allowed, amber means caution or pending, and red means denied, failed, or destructive. Never use these colors as decoration.

rules.name: The Operational Scale Rule
rules.body: Use compact hierarchy and weight before increasing size; giant text is outside the Kiki console language.

rules.name: The Desktop Contract Rule
rules.body: The 1100px gate is a product constraint, not a responsive suggestion: no application shell or dashboard exists below it.

rules.name: The Flat Console Rule
rules.body: Keep operational cards border-defined and flat; apply ambient shadow only when a surface must float above the working plane.

rules.name: The Bounded State Rule
rules.body: Reserve pill geometry for status, role, and permission labels; ordinary actions and containers remain compact rounded rectangles.

dos: Do preserve the established Kiki black/navy operational console and its persistent desktop shell.
Do use cool one-pixel borders and tonal layering to order dense information.
Do keep blue primary actions restrained and semantic green, amber, and red consistent.
Do place permission and local-only prototype state at the point of work.
Do use compact outlined icons, tabular numerals for operational data, and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a generic SaaS admin template.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, ornamental glow, or shadows on resting cards.
Don't use giant display text where compact hierarchy will do.
Don't convert ordinary actions or containers into excessive pills.
Don't render, squeeze, or stack the application shell below the 1100px desktop gate.
Don't imply that hidden or disabled controls provide production authorization.
